intro: Section 24.1 covers psychiatric rehabilitation: its aims and recovery-oriented values, supported employment, social skills training (with the components of social skill in Table 24-1), social perception and problem-solving training, milieu therapy and token economies, cognitive rehabilitation, and the ethics of working with patients as partners. Update boxes add the IPS and cognitive remediation evidence.
objectives: Define psychiatric rehabilitation and its priorities.
Describe supported employment and how it differs from train-then-place models.
Outline how social skills training runs and name the components of social skill.
Explain social perception training and the six-step problem-solving strategy.
Describe milieu therapy, token economies and cognitive rehabilitation.
Apply the ethics of autonomy and confidentiality in rehabilitation.
